title: Notify the council of a public pool before it is used
what: Notify the local council of a public swimming pool or spa pool before letting anyone use it, and keep it disinfected and clean (s 36).

sources.title: Public Health Act 2010 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: The occupier of premises at which a public swimming pool or spa pool is situated must not allow a person to use the pool unless the occupier has caused notice of the pool's existence to be given to the person prescribed by the regulations
